record.raw_message: Hello team, I hope you are well. I wanted to give some background first. We have been ArcVault customers for about three years and overall the experience has been positive; our operations team uses the platform daily and our finance team relies on the monthly reporting. Over the last quarter we onboarded two new subsidiaries and the number of seats roughly doubled, which went smoothly thanks to your onboarding folks. Last week our IT director asked me to review our tooling ahead of the annual budget cycle, so I have been going through each system in detail. While doing that I noticed something in the API: when we call the /v2/reports endpoint with a date range longer than 90 days we get error code RPT-4127 and an empty payload, even though the documentation says ranges up to 365 days are supported. Shorter ranges work fine. This affects only my account (ops-admin@northwind) as far as I can tell. It is not urgent, but we would like it fixed before our budget review at the end of next month. Thanks in advance, and apologies for the long email.
